cee806ed390ca8807ba01f7930ed4643f1ca33c6:
query ListScenes($storyboardId: ID!) {
  scenes(storyboardId: $storyboardId) {
    id
    storyboardId
    sceneNumber
    textDescription
    mediaType
    mediaUrl
    startTimeSeconds
    durationSeconds
    transitionType
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
19626e605bc5663fb2a694727b960ae073d04e95:
query GetScene($id: ID!) {
  scene(id: $id) {
    id
    storyboardId
    sceneNumber
    textDescription
    mediaType
    mediaUrl
    startTimeSeconds
    durationSeconds
    transitionType
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
020714cd4c3857355d66b504f0d780980c7de495:
mutation ReorderScenes($input: ReorderScenesInput!) {
  reorderScenes(input: $input) {
    id
    storyboardId
    sceneNumber
    textDescription
    mediaType
    mediaUrl
    startTimeSeconds
    durationSeconds
    transitionType
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}
